files.intake_terms.md:
# Ruskington Beet Slicers - intake charges

Intake is charged at 3.20 pounds a tonne of beet delivered.

A load of more than 28 tonnes is charged at half the rate on the whole load.
files.README.md:
# Ruskington Beet Slicers - beet intake, October 2026

One row per load; tonnes is the weight of the load at the factory weighbridge.
